name: Python 脚本示例：检查游戏画面

steps.name: 读取分辨率与保存截图

params.code:
width, height = game.size()
print(f"游戏分辨率：{width} × {height}")
assert width >= 1024 and height >= 700, "游戏客户区过小"
variables["size"] = [width, height]
image = game.capture()
assert image.size == (width, height)
print("已保存游戏截图，报告目录：", report_dir)
print("前一步记录的分辨率：", variables["size"])
